arguments.code: var inventory = s => ({imports:s.match(/^(?:Require Import|From .* Require Import).*$/gm),theorems:s.match(/^Theorem .*$/gm),prints:s.match(/^Print Assumptions .*$/gm)}); if(JSON.stringify(inventory(candidate)) !== JSON.stringify(inventory(reference))) throw new Error('Preserved inventory mismatch'); if(/\b(?:Admitted|admit|Axiom|Parameter)\b|propositional_extensionality/.test(reference)) throw new Error('Forbidden proof content'); await fs.writeFile(base + '/Candidate.v', reference, 'utf8'); var saved = await fs.readFile(base + '/Candidate.v','utf8'); if(saved !== reference) throw new Error('Readback mismatch'); nodeRepl.write({updated:'Candidate.v',theorems:inventory(saved).theorems.length,printAssumptions:inventory(saved).prints.length,exactCertificateCopy:true});
